data.source_description: Unverified daily Gold OHLC proxy, 2000-01-04 to 2022-09-02, Kaggle mirror, not broker spot XAUUSD

ea_review.note: Static source review is not compilation, a tick backtest, or live approval

limitations: No strategy can be certified profitable or professional by an in-sample or walk-forward backtest alone
Python Bid-bar results are not MT5 real-tick results and do not include swaps or broker-specific contract changes
The live calendar news filter is not reproduced by this CSV engine
A PAPER_CANDIDATE still requires MT5 compilation, real-tick testing and demo forward validation
New entries are disabled in the generated MT5 set file

validation.method: Rolling fixed-length walk-forward; parameters selected on training only, then tested once on the next unseen window
